quality.reason: Output contains only garbled characters and the launcher shell command itself; the actual scanner results were redirected to /tmp/x_scan_run.txt, so no actionable crypto signal is present.

Well-structured status with useful health and PnL metrics, but the signals section is noise-heavy: claims 9 active yet lists 8, contains duplicate BTC/HYPE entries all with weak strengths (0.40-0.51), and the negative PnL flag lacks any actionable context or recommendation.

Well-structured review that cleanly reports flat positions and strategy health with trend deltas, and surfaces a genuinely actionable anomaly (SOL assigned strategy has no score while runner-up 'trend' scores 78.95), though the truncated mismatch explanation and missing SOL score data prevent a top rating.

Well-structured with clear top-line orderbook signals (SOL 84% bid, HYPE 77% ask) and a clean data table, but the identical 0.0013% funding rate across all coins suggests stale or placeholder data, and despite the 'Whale Monitor' name it contains no actual whale transaction alerts, limiting its actionable value.

The output synthesizes scattered snippets into well-structured, coherent themes (geopolitics, AI regulation, crypto, emerging markets) with clear formatting and analytical framing, delivering genuine digest value rather than raw repetition, though the truncated preview prevents confirming deeper specifics.

Dense, actionable fleet metrics with clear failure signals (news-agent -12.5, meta 0 briefs, whale-mon 0% uptime), but prompt-leakage prefix ('Now produce the final Discord report:') and the whale-mon score/uptime inconsistency detract from an otherwise well-structured report.

Well-structured digest with verifiable paper IDs, links, authors, and relevant topic coverage, but the top paper dates from ~3 months before the scan date (staleness/redundancy risk for a recurring scanner) and the truncated output prevents full assessment of all five entries.

Well-structured quantitative research with a clear falsifiable thesis, concrete EV/alpha comparisons across assets, and a highly actionable finding (zero signal edge, sell signals destroy capital) that directly informs trading strategy decisions.
